spellbook.finance/limitations: This writes a combined-shipping rule that can affect eligible listings across all of the caller's workspaces; workspaceId validates owner access only. It requires agent_marketplace_publish authorization.

The rule is a seller-selected offer, not a profit guarantee or proof of checkout behavior. Provider readback does not prove listing association or checkout; use returned missingFields and limitations.

description: Set an explicit eBay combined-shipping rule and optionally change its promotional shipping threshold for the caller's connected account, then return provider readback. Read spellbook_ebay_combined_shipping_get first. workspaceId proves workspace ownership; it does not select another eBay account.

combinedDuration.description: Seller-selected buyer accumulation window. Defaults to Days_7.

eachAdditionalAmountUsd.description: Seller-selected shipping charge for each additional item in USD. Defaults to 0.

profileName.description: Seller-selected eBay rule name. Defaults to SpellBook Finance Combined Shipping.

promotionalShippingRule.description: Optional seller-selected promotional shipping threshold and charge. Omit it to preserve the existing promotion.

orderAmountUsd.description: Minimum order subtotal for promotional shipping in USD. Required.

shippingCostUsd.description: Shipping charged at the threshold in USD; use zero for free shipping. Required.

workspaceId.description: Workspace the caller owns; used for delegated authorization. Required.

name: spellbook_ebay_combined_shipping_set
